source_review.method: Read all 10 original PDF pages and visually reviewed page renders and all 11 complete 300-dpi crops. Cross-checked title/author/DOI, knockout and heterologous expression observations, substrate-feeding results, reported product assignments and the separation of measured outcomes from proposed pathway steps. Zotero title_match cache flag conflicts with the PDF; PDF front page confirms the record identity.
minor_issues: Zotero inventory title_match=false conflicts with the PDF front page; original PDF title, DOI and journal metadata match, so the inventory cache flag is treated as stale.

verified_claims.evidence: Title, authors, Chemical Science 2021 citation and DOI 10.1039/D1SC02666F match the Zotero record; article is an English primary research paper.

verified_claims.claim: Core usg genes and deletion phenotypes
verified_claims.evidence: uvpks1 deletion abolishes products; usgM deletion shifts to nonmethylated products; usgL deletion yields semi-ustilaginoidins; combinatorial usgD deletions reveal dehydration-related products.
Sixteen A. oryzae gene combinations connect uvpks1, usgD, usgM, usgR and usgL to reported product patterns; host/nonenzymatic contributions remain possible for some dehydration.
Mutant profiles and transient products support a proposed route in which YWA1-like monomers dimerize before dehydration; unstable intermediates lacked NMR confirmation.
Cell-free extract expressing UsgL forms multiple homo- and heterodimers; substrate preference varies with methylation and reduction state, and atroposelectivity varies with protein concentration.
Feeding supports reduction of linear monomers 2 and 4, with 2R products; no conversion of representative dimers or tested chromen-4-one analogs was reported.
Ratios of isomers 6 and 7 vary across tested media, buffers and solvents; the authors attribute this to nonenzymatic keto-enol tautomerism, with host components possibly promoting it.

Expression combinations did not support the proposed reductase role; UsgO-associated changes in dehydration ratios prompted a speculative inhibitory side-dehydration explanation, not a demonstrated catalytic mechanism.
All seven figures, one scheme and three tables have complete crops including their captions and essential labels.

unresolved_source_issues: The attached Zotero PDF contains the 10-page main text but not the ESI; detailed construction methods, complete spectra and supplementary repeat information could not be checked.
The main text does not report explicit biological replicate counts or statistical tests for the displayed profiles.
Full-length soluble UsgR, its kinetic parameters, cofactor/electron donor and structural mechanism were not established.
Some unstable proposed intermediates were not confirmed by NMR; pathway order in Scheme 1 remains partly inferential.
The UsgO role and the putative cluster-external hydroxymethylation branch remain unresolved.
